fields.System.Title: INV-101 — Query stock by location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want to see everything held in a location, so that I can answer
"what is on that shelf?" without walking to it.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a location holding stock, when I query it, then I get every product, batch,
  • and status with its on-hand, reserved, and available quantities.
  • - Given an empty location, then I get an empty result, not an error.
  • - Given a location that does not exist, then I get 404.
  • - Given a virtual location, then it can be queried like any other.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | inventory |
| Tables | stock_balance |
| Risks | Returning a bare quantity field without saying which quantity ([doc 04 §3.3](../../../docs/04-modules.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
